metadata.title: Durvalumab 1500 mg Monotherapy – 28 day
metadata.indication: Adult PD-L1 ≥1% unresectable stage III NSCLC without progression after definitive concurrent platinum chemoradiation.
metadata.safety_correction: Cytotoxic ANC and platelet hold thresholds removed; ICI-specific adverse-event rules encoded.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical and pharmacy validation pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Fresh official source, page/table boundaries and executable rules reconciled; this is not independent clinical authorisation.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.treatment_intent: Consolidation following definitive concurrent CRT in a curative-intent stage III pathway
metadata.schedule_summary: Durvalumab is infused on Day 1 of each 28-day cycle. The course lasts up to 12 months (13 cycles), and can finish earlier if the cancer progresses or side effects make continuation unsuitable. The first dose should start within 42 days after chemoradiotherapy finishes.
metadata.component_scope: Durvalumab monotherapy only; the preceding CRT has its own protocol and support
metadata.patient_suite_context: Consolidation for unresectable stage III non-small-cell lung cancer after concurrent platinum chemotherapy and radiotherapy, with no cancer progression and tumour PD-L1 of at least 1%.
metadata.retrospective_audit_note: v0.84.26: fresh NCCP version unchanged; corrected bilirubin rule precedence for combined hepatic abnormalities under footnote b; independent organ stop rules retained.

source_supplements.label: EMA Imfinzi product information · sections 4.2–4.6, 5.1
source_supplements.basis: Audited product information supplement; NCCP differences remain explicit

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Consultant discussion of every modification. No dose-reduction ladder. Omitted domains remain unassessed; source Table1 CTCAE4.03 and specific event identity take precedence over generic grades.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

indications.description: Adult PD-L1 ≥1% unresectable stage III NSCLC without progression after definitive concurrent platinum chemoradiation.

treatment_phases.label: Durvalumab consolidation after completed concurrent CRT
treatment_phases.duration_text: Until progression or unacceptable toxicity, maximum 12 months (13 cycles). Begin cycle 1 within 42 days of completing concurrent CRT.

administration.notes: 250 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 60 minutes; low-protein-binding 0.2–0.22 micrometre inline filter; separate line. Final concentration 1–15 mg/mL. At body weight ≤30 kg, fixed 1500 mg must not be used: separately prescribe 10 mg/kg q2w or 20 mg/kg q4w until >30 kg.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Durvalumab monotherapy is minimal emetogenic risk in the current NCCP regimen supportive-care section.

treatment.schedule_summary: Durvalumab 1500 mg IV Day 1 every 28 days, maximum 12 months (13 cycles); start within 42 days after CRT.

eligibility.summary: Adults, ECOG 0–1, PD-L1 ≥1%, unresectable stage III NSCLC, no progression after ≥2 concurrent platinum cycles and ≥60 Gy radiation; adequate organ function.

exclusions.summary: See source p2 and executable exclusion/caution rules; sequential CRT and mixed SCLC/NSCLC are outside scope. Prior PD-1/PD-L1 treatment refers to separate NCCP policy.

baseline: FBC, renal/liver profile, blood glucose and thyroid function
HBsAg, HBcoreAb and hepatitis C screening
Validated PD-L1; review CRT timing, radiation-related pulmonary effects and medicines
regular: FBC, renal/liver profile, glucose and thyroid function regularly per team plan
Review immune, pulmonary, endocrine and infection symptoms before treatment and between visits
Disease monitoring according to consultant treatment plan

dose_modifications.summary: Dose escalation/reduction is not recommended for durvalumab toxicity. Apply withholding/discontinuation criteria and consultant review; general resumption within 12 weeks requires grade ≤1 and prednisone equivalent ≤10 mg/day. CTCAE4.03 is the NCCP table standard.
